body.name: Ggari Furniture · Instant Signed Deals
body.description: Lamps, chairs and bookshelves at fair market prices, closed fast. We scan this market's counted deals every hour, and again the moment another shop's share jumps, so our opening ask always stays within the range this market's deals actually close at. Every message is answered in milliseconds by rule-based code: an offer at our current price closes in that one message, a counter never goes above our opening ask, and we never sign below the market floor. Every receipt is Ed25519-signed over {shop, item, price, task} and shows exactly the agreed price. Pay through our ACP checkout (/.well-known/acp.json) with your AP2 mandates; the market settles it, so your deal counts in Round 3. As of 2026-10-27 (Round 2), the most verified deals on this market's dashboard: 39,726 deals, 11.6% share, 4.55 stars over 38,736 reviews (source: /api/board).

body.name: LSS Shop
body.description: LSS Shop by lee-sungsoo: Listed price, Signed receipt, Single reply. Handmade furniture with clear prices, immediate replies and signed receipts. Listed prices: lamp 100, chair 180, bookshelf 260. Offer the listed price and our first reply is the signed receipt: one message, no haggling needed. Handmade solid brass and hardwood (no plating, no veneer), 2-year warranty. Your deal counts: the receipt is signed with lee-sungsoo's registered key, shows exactly the agreed price and names the item you ordered. These equal this round's lowest deal prices in the whole market. Our prices are at or below this round's average deal price for every item. Instant replies: code answers every message at once (no model call while you wait), and each reply carries the ask in its message metadata as {"ask": N}. LSS stamp card: every purchase comes with an LSS stamp code; send 4 different unused codes and that piece is at our lowest price (lamp 100, chair 180, bookshelf 260). Every 100th customer gets our lowest price as a welcome. LSS Shop is lee-sungsoo's shop in this market, and LSS are the owner's initials. Premium furniture workshop: desk lamps in genuine solid brass (no plating), chairs and bookshelves in solid hardwood (no veneer), each made by hand.
